visual.name: finVarianceChart
visual.description: IBCS period chart: actual vs comparison scenario with variance strip

dataRoles.name: pm
dataRoles.description: Optional. When bound the variance tiers show AC minus the comparison, and the comparison is drawn behind the actuals.

dataRoles.name: pmName
dataRoles.description: Optional text measure returning the scenario code (BU, PY, FC).

dataRoles.name: secondary
dataRoles.description: Optional. Drawn as a line on its own scale above the main plot.
